content.text: Yes, this is really common at 20 months. Toddlers this age often start waking at night around a new burst of language, teething, or a change in routine. Tonight, try going in quickly and keeping it boring: low voice, no lights, no playing, a short "night night, I'm here," then leave while they're still drowsy. If they have a fever or seem unwell, call 811 any time.
